$comment: Kun Fayakun Intelligence: the guide's words, the assistant's notices and suggestions, and the templates the knowledge index is built with (scripts/build-ai-index.ts). Loaded with the assistant's own chunk (src/ai/index.ts). Simulations integrate ahead; nothing here says a text foretold anything.
ai.mind.index.plainTitle: {key} in plain words (an explanation, not a translation)
ai.mind.index.placeText: {name}: a populated place at latitude {lat}°, longitude {lon}°, home to about {population} people.
ai.mind.index.starText: {name}: a star of visual magnitude {vmag} (HR {hr}), at right ascension {ra}° and declination {dec}° (J2000).
ai.mind.index.constellationText: {name} ({id}): one of the 88 constellations recognised today. The explorer draws its figure in the sky.
ai.mind.guide.found: Here is what the app’s verified content says.
ai.mind.guide.nothing: I could not find that in the app’s verified content. Try other words, or ask about a chapter, a verse, a world, the explorer or the laboratory.
ai.mind.guide.facts: The numbers come from the app’s data and its calculators.
ai.mind.guide.notConfirmed: I asked the app to do this, but it did not show the change in time: {what}
ai.mind.guide.failed: Something went wrong while trying this: {what}
ai.mind.guide.awaiting: This changes the laboratory, so it waits for you to confirm it: {what}
ai.mind.guide.decline: That is outside what this app can help with. Ask about creation, the chapters, the verses, the solar system or the laboratory.
ai.mind.notice.empty: Ask a question or give a command.
ai.mind.notice.truncated: Your question was long, so only its first 600 characters were read.
ai.mind.notice.planFallback: The model’s plan could not be used, so this answer comes from the app’s own content.
ai.mind.notice.engineError: The model stopped with an error, so the guide answered instead.
ai.mind.notice.experimentCancelled: Cancelled. Nothing in the laboratory changed.
ai.mind.notice.noKnowledge: The app’s verified content could not be loaded, so nothing was looked up.
ai.mind.notice.failed: Something went wrong, and this question could not be answered.
ai.mind.notice.guarded: Some of the model’s words were changed or removed to keep to the app’s rules.
ai.mind.announce.awaiting: An experiment is waiting for you to confirm it.
ai.mind.announce.engineError: {model} could not be loaded. The guide answers meanwhile.
ai.mind.announce.engineOff: The model was unloaded after ten idle minutes, to free memory. It loads again with your next question.
ai.mind.announce.guide: Using the guide: no model, answers from the app’s own content.
ai.mind.suggest.chapter.1: What do classical commentators say here?
ai.mind.suggest.explorer.2: How long does light take from the Sun to Neptune?
ai.mind.suggest.lab.1: What if the Sun were twice as massive?
ai.mind.suggest.lab.3: Throw a rock at the Earth
ai.mind.suggest.lab.4: Compare the solar system with and without Jupiter
ai.mind.suggest.sources.1: Where does the translation come from?
